title: Viva Engage: collapse and resize the left navigation, and favourite and reorder more communities
summary: The briefing accurately reports the revised rollout window, user-initiated behaviour and conflicting favourites limits. No actionable error was found; the licensing model understates the published product-level entitlement and should name Viva Engage Core with its licensing-enforcement qualification.

claims.quote: If you do enforce Viva Engage licensing ... each user must have ... a Microsoft 365 license ... a Viva Engage Core Service Plan. ... Viva Engage Core or Yammer enterprise ... Engage core experiences ... Microsoft 365
claims.fix: Set licensing.model to included and cite https://learn.microsoft.com/viva/engage/setup. Replace 'Licensing is Not yet published' and the opening licensing note with: 'Viva Engage Core or Yammer enterprise comes with Microsoft 365. If Viva Engage licensing is enforced, each user needs a Microsoft 365 license and a Viva Engage Core Service Plan; if it is not enforced, users can still access the Core experience. Microsoft has not published a licence requirement specific to these navigation controls.'
